summary: Frontend-only testing of the multi-photo Iron Stag scan flow against the local backend (ANALYSIS_MOCK_MODEL=true). Verified: login + onboarding + Scan tab, hint 'You can add up to 3 photos...', file-chooser based photo add on web, PhotoTray with testIDs photo-tray/photo-thumb-N/photo-add/photo-guidance/photo-crop-button/photo-preview-main, add tile disappears at MAX=3, 'Analyze 3 Photos' button, reorder (photo-move-right-1), remove (photo-remove-3), re-add via photo-add, CropModal (crop-modal + crop-handle-br + crop-apply/reset/cancel), multi-photo analyze -> navigates to /scan-result/<id>, result-main-image + result-photo-strip + result-photo-1..3 + multi-photo-evidence with text '3 photos analyzed together', scans_remaining dropped exactly 1 (88->87, verified via API), single-photo scan returns a result with NO photo strip and NO evidence card. Mock model returns 3.5y Buck as expected. Backend was pointed at the local preview URL (EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL temporarily switched for testing, then reverted to the production railway URL).

ui_bugs.issue: Dragging crop-handle-br with Playwright mouse (down/move/up on the handle's bounding box) did not resize the crop frame — the 'Cropped for analysis' pill did not appear after Apply. Likely a Playwright-vs-PanResponder interaction limitation on web (RN's PanResponder may not translate synthetic mouse events into dx/dy as expected). Crop modal otherwise opens, Reset/Cancel/Apply all work, and all testIDs (crop-modal, crop-frame, crop-handle-tl/tr/bl/br, crop-apply, crop-cancel, crop-reset) are present. Needs manual verification on real touch device or an alternative drag path (e.g., touch events).

The pencil (edit) and trash (delete) icons in the Scan Result header do not have testIDs. This made it impossible to reliably click them from Playwright and so the 'Re-analysis Complete' (via the edit modal on a 3-photo scan) and 'Delete the scan from the result screen' flows were not UI-verified. Both icons are visually present in the header. Please add testIDs such as scan-edit-button and scan-delete-button.

action_items: Add testID to the pencil/edit button and trash/delete button in /app/frontend/app/scan-result/[id].tsx header (e.g., scan-edit-button and scan-delete-button) so the edit modal + delete flows can be exercised deterministically.

Manually verify crop drag + 'Cropped for analysis' pill on a real device (or with touch events) — the mouse-driven drag through PanResponder could not be exercised reliably from Playwright on web, but the handles/modal/apply all render and the crop state wiring (CropRect in CropModal.apply) looks correct.
(Nice-to-have) Give the bottom tab bar links a testID (e.g., tab-scan) — the current <a href="/scan"> is found but has element-not-visible issues under Playwright, so tests have to click via JS.
critical_code_review_comments: scan.tsx addPhotos: setSelectedIndex uses `photos.length + normalized.length - 1` but `photos` is the stale state inside the closure. In practice this still works because photos is captured at call time, but using the functional updater's new array length (prev.length + normalized.length - 1) would be more robust when multiple adds overlap.

scan.tsx removePhoto: the `if (photos.length <= 1) setScanStep('main')` check reads `photos.length` from the stale closure (pre-removal). It still produces the correct final behavior but is confusing — prefer computing newLen inside the updater.
updated_files: /app/frontend/.env (temporarily pointed EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL at the preview URL for testing against the local mock backend; reverted to https://ironstag-production.up.railway.app after testing)

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (multi-photo add/reorder/remove/crop-open/analyze/result/single-photo result all pass; crop pill + edit/delete icons not UI-verified due to PanResponder/testID issues)

seed_data_creation: Generated 4 random 500x400 JPEGs in /tmp/testimg/. Created real scans in the local DB for the multiphoto.test@ironstag.dev account via the UI (scans_remaining went 88 -> 87 after the 3-photo analyze; the follow-up 1-photo analyze decremented it again).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL (currently pointed back at the production Railway URL). To exercise the mocked model again, temporarily set EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://date-persist-deploy.preview.emergentagent.com in /app/frontend/.env and `sudo supervisorctl restart expo`. The multiphoto.test@ironstag.dev user exists on both the local and the Railway backends. Login path is /login, onboarding is Continue -> Accept & Continue, and the Scan tab must be reached by clicking the in-app bottom-tab anchor (direct goto /scan loses the auth state in the current Expo build on web). Always install `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())` because Alert.alert maps to window.alert/confirm on web.
rca_of_issue: N/A — the multi-photo feature works end-to-end. The only two gaps are tooling (missing testIDs on edit/delete, PanResponder vs. Playwright mouse).
